name: anki-band
description: Review your Anki cards in a band above the prompt while Claude works: one key shows the answer, one grades it, and the due count sits in the status line

query.title: Cards to review
query.description: An Anki search, such as deck:"Japanese" or deck:ML tag:core; empty reviews the whole collection

newPerDay.title: New cards a day
newPerDay.description: How many new cards to introduce a day; -1 uses the deck's own limit when the search names one deck, else 20

heading.title: Heading template
heading.description: The dim line above the question, in Anki's template syntax ({{Field}}, {{#Field}}…{{/Field}}); empty shows the deck

front.title: Question template
front.description: The question, in Anki's template syntax; empty uses the card as Anki renders it

back.title: Answer template
back.description: The answer, in Anki's template syntax, one row per line; empty uses the card's answer side as Anki renders it

showWhenIdle.title: Show when idle
showWhenIdle.description: Keep the band up while Claude is waiting for you, not only while it works

syncAfter.title: Sync with AnkiWeb after
syncAfter.description: Sync Anki with AnkiWeb after this many grades, and as the session ends when any are not synced yet; 0 never syncs. Anki must be logged in to AnkiWeb
